## About
General Mecanic is a family business on Grier Rd in Charlotte. The owner's father started the shop with one goal: give people auto service that meets a high standard of quality. We still follow that policy today.
Juan Carrera and Gilberto Salas co-own the shop and run the tow truck. Denis Lazo is our foreman and technician, and Reyna Salgado will greet you at the front desk as your service advisor. Every repair is done right here on-site, so your vehicle stays with us from start to finish.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating across 222 Google reviews. Stop by, or call or text and tell us what your car is doing.

## Services
- Diagnostics: We test your vehicle's electrical system to find the real cause of a problem, whether it's the battery, alternator, starter, wiring or sensors, so you only pay for the repair you need. Diagnostics start at $120. ($120)
- North Carolina safety inspection: The yearly inspection you need before renewing your plate. We check brakes, tires, lights and signals, steering and suspension, wipers, mirrors and horn.
- North Carolina emission inspection: A computer check (OBD-II) required in some counties along with your safety inspection. A check engine light means the car will fail, so it pays to get that looked at first.
- Oil changes and tune-ups: Routine maintenance to keep your daily driver dependable.
- Brake repairs: Brake work done at the shop by our technicians.
- Engine and transmission work: We remove the old unit, prepare every connection, and install a new, rebuilt or used engine or transmission to factory specs, including fluids, sensors, wiring and mounts.
- Suspension and steering: Worn shocks, struts, ball joints and bushings cause noises, a rough ride and uneven tire wear. We inspect, repair and replace them.
- Heating and A/C: A/C not blowing cold or heater not warming up? We find the cause, recharge refrigerant and replace worn parts.
- Tires: Tire inspections, rotations, balancing, repairs and replacements.
- Wheel alignment: We align your vehicle to its original specifications for a smoother ride.
- Towing: Our co-owners run the tow truck, any hour of the day.

## FAQ
Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Diagnostics start at $120. That test tells us what's wrong so we can give you the total cost of the repair.

Q: I only need a small job. Will you do it?
A: Yes. Big or small, we handle all kinds of automotive repairs.

Q: Do you work on business vehicles?
A: We do. We service commercial vehicles, and our pricing is the same for every customer.

Q: My check engine light is on. Will I pass the emission inspection?
A: No. A vehicle with a check engine light on will fail, so we recommend a diagnostic first.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: You can call or text us any day of the week.
